summary: The diff shows substantial i18n adoption across AdminPanel, ParentDashboard, ChildHome, and several components by replacing many visible strings with `t(...)` calls and adding/expanding en/pt-BR dictionaries. However, there is evidence that some user-visible strings remain hardcoded (notably content filter category names), and the diff summary does not provide enough evidence to confirm fallback/typing guarantees or full reactive language switching behavior across all mounted UI (e.g., persistence via localStorage, open dialogs). There are also non-requested UI/styling and auth/admin-gate behavior changes mentioned in the change summaries.

missing_requirements.requirement: Replace all hardcoded UI strings across the app with i18n translation keys so that switching the language applies to every screen, tab, and conditional/empty state.
missing_requirements.reason: At least some user-visible strings remain hardcoded (English) rather than translated via `t(...)` (e.g., content filter category names). This violates the requirement that all visible strings be translated and that no user-visible English remains in authenticated flows (excluding user-generated content).
evidence: frontend/src/components/filters/ContentFilterEditor.tsx (DEFAULT_CATEGORIES uses 'Adult Content', 'Violence', 'Gambling', 'Social Media', 'Gaming' as literal strings)

missing_requirements.requirement: Update translation dictionaries to fully cover all UI text used by the app, with pt-BR complete and en as fallback; preserve strong typing and fallback behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: While en.ts and pt-BR.ts were modified, the diff summary is truncated and does not demonstrate that all newly introduced keys across the modified components are present in both dictionaries, nor does it show any mechanism/verification for strong typing preservation or fallback-to-en behavior when pt-BR keys are missing.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure language switching updates consistently for currently mounted and newly rendered UI (tabs, dialogs/modals, conditional sections) without refresh, and persists via existing localStorage mechanism (appLanguage).
missing_requirements.reason: Many components now use `useI18n()`/`t(...)`, which helps reactivity, but the diff summary does not show changes (or confirm no regressions) in the LanguageSelector/i18n provider regarding live updates for open dialogs/modals and persistence via `localStorage` key `appLanguage`. Those mechanisms are not evidenced in the shown diffs.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions language selector, but no concrete diff shown)

hallucinated_features.description: Theme-token-based styling and contrast refactors across layout/auth components (replacing hard-coded colors, hover states, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest is strictly about completing pt-BR translations/i18n coverage and explicitly states no feature-set changes beyond localization; styling refactors are not requested.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (entries for frontend/src/App.tsx, frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx, frontend/src/components/layout/AppFooter.tsx, frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton.tsx mention theme-token-based styling/contrast updates)

hallucinated_features.description: Admin gate behavior changes such as clearing the admin gate on logout and additional admin password management UX changes beyond translation.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by the BuildRequest (which focuses on translation/i18n).
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton.tsx mentions admin gate clearing on logout; frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPasswordGate.tsx modified beyond pure string replacement, per summary)
